# Transmuter

> Value recovery infrastructure for tokens on Solana. Reserves, escrow and end of life rules are fixed before trading.

- [Home](https://www.transmuter.net/): Launch a token with an isolated treasury, contract-owned liquidity and end of life rules fixed before trading.
- [Docs](https://www.transmuter.net/docs/): How reserves, escrow, fees and end of life work.
- [FAQ](https://www.transmuter.net/faq/): Answers on backing, escrow, governance, fees and audits.
- [Glossary](https://www.transmuter.net/glossary/): Definitions for EOL token, cToken, escrow, treasury, redemption ratio and cGold.
- [Holders](https://www.transmuter.net/holders/): What a holder can check, vote on and redeem.
- [Integrate](https://www.transmuter.net/integrate/): How another launch platform uses the same infrastructure.
- [Launchpad](https://www.transmuter.net/launchpad/): Create an EOL token.
- [Access](https://www.transmuter.net/access/): Request a place in the beta.
- [Contact](https://www.transmuter.net/contact/): Write to the team at info@transmuter.net.
